genesis300AndDrawV2Pool.note: Follow-on deploy next to the existing testnet stack. Does not redeploy Launch, Token, Router, or the skeleton DrawV2. Genesis is funded with 8M TWAK from the ecosystem/deployer wallet and the window is open. New DrawV2 is a stand-alone instant pool wheel seeded with 5M TWAK (testnet stand-in; the 70M allocation stays locked in the skeleton at drawV2Legacy because that contract has no withdraw and TowackLaunch.drawV2Treasury is immutable). Genesis gates on a new MockAgentIdNFT because the existing MockAgentId has no token ids/ownerOf. Launch still uses the original MockAgentId.
